title: 小小英文新鲜事 - 1128 | 婴儿行星、长颈鹿宝宝、环球飞行
description:
🎧 本期音频为全英文，适合有一定英语基础的小朋友。

👧 今天 Mia 和 Lina 聊了三个新鲜事：

🪐 科学家发现了一颗不到一百万岁的“婴儿行星”，它还在不停长大！
🦒 辛辛那提动物园迎来长颈鹿宝宝，出生就和大人一样高，八千人在线围观接生！
✈️ 一架大飞机不落地飞了一万四千多英里，机组人员一天看到了两次日落！

📖 Word of the day: planet（行星）

🎮 谜语时间：我不到一岁，却比一千头大象还大；我住在太空里，还在不停长大。我是谁？答案：婴儿行星！

---
🇬🇧 In today's episode:

🪐 Scientists found a baby planet less than one million years old, and it is still growing!
🦒 A baby giraffe was born at the Cincinnati Zoo, as tall as a grown up on day one, and almost eight thousand people watched her being born online!
✈️ A giant plane flew fourteen thousand three hundred eighty eight miles without landing, and the crew saw two sunsets in one day!

📖 Word of the day: planet

🎮 Riddle time: I am younger than one, but bigger than a thousand elephants. I live in space, and I am still growing. What am I? A baby planet!

📝 生词本 Words to learn

1. planet（行星）
A planet is a big round world that goes around a star.
例：The baby planet is still growing!（这颗婴儿行星还在长大！）

2. telescope（望远镜）
A telescope is a tool that helps you see things that are very far away.
例：Scientists watched the planet with a giant telescope.（科学家用一台巨大的望远镜观察这颗行星。）

3. giraffe（长颈鹿）
A giraffe is a tall animal with a very long neck.
例：The baby giraffe is as tall as a grown up!（小长颈鹿和大人一样高！）

4. sunset（日落）
A sunset is when the sun goes down in the evening.
例：The plane crew saw two sunsets in one day!（机组人员一天看到了两次日落！）
